story_type: divers stranded on a capsized hull, boat crew pickup
hook: Ten miles out, standing on their flipped boat.
narration: Their boat flipped ten miles off Florida, and two divers were left standing on the hull.
A Coast Guard boat crew from Station Cortez came out to get them.
A capsized hull can roll or sink at any moment, so rescuers get people off it fast.
One at a time, the crew reached across and hauled them over the rail.
outcome: Both divers were transferred safely to another rescue boat, with no injuries reported.
title: Two divers stuck on a flipped boat
description:
Two divers were left standing on their capsized boat 10 miles west of Bean Point, Anna Maria, Florida, on Aug. 24, 2015. A Coast Guard Station Cortez Response Boat-Medium crew pulled them aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Station Cortez, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/420853/coast-guard-rescues-2-divers-after-boat-capsizes
